in_sanskrit.name: Paban
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of creation
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Paban एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Pitra-pavan’, meaning ‘Lord of the Forefathers’ or ‘Lord of creation'. In Hindu mythology, Pitra represents ancestors and Pavan signifies wind god, symbolizing the connection between the past, present, and future.
